{"code": "import scipy.stats as stats

# Perform a t-test for biomarker change between arms
control_change = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control']['biomarker_change']
treatment_change = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']['biomarker_change']

# Check for normality
print("Normality check (Shapiro-Wilk):")
print("Control change p-value:", stats.shapiro(control_change)[1])
print("Treatment change p-value:", stats.shapiro(treatment_change)[1])

# Since the data is not normally distributed, use Mann-Whitney U test
print("\nMann-Whitney U test (non-parametric):")
u_stat, p_value = stats.mannwhitneyu(control_change, treatment_change, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"U statistic: {u_stat}, p-value: {p_value}")

# Calculate effect size (rank-biserial correlation)
effect_size = 1 - (2 * u_stat) / (len(control_change) * len(treatment_change))
print(f"Effect size (rank-biserial correlation): {effect_size}")"}
